_note: TEACHES DRAGON TAMING. Won by obtaining a dragon.
This scenario is a bit different from the others.
You are not trying to destroy your opponent,
but rather to find and tame a dragon. The dragon
is located somewhere across the river, and you
will need to build an army to get there.
The dragon is a neutral unit, so you will
need to attack it to tame it
name: How To Find a Dragon and Tame It
description: Somewhere across the river is a Dragons nest. Build an army, go and find it, Kill the Dragon and tame the baby Dragon.
message:
Objective: Destroy The Dragon AND Tame the baby.

Overview: Train soldiers at the barracks, select them, and tap The Dragon to attack. Use the minimap to find the nest -- it is somewhere across the river.

Killing the Dragon will reveal a baby in the nest.
